thread:
alex: Heads-up — we got a flood of KV eviction alerts between 02:10-02:30 UTC. Lots of noisy pager activity, looks correlated with a traffic spike + longer prompt sessions.

maria: saw that, was wondering if sampling/rollup window is hiding the true spike shape. our alert is on `kv_eviction_rate > 50 for 5m` which aggregates over 1m rollups.

cheng: can you paste the PromQL you used? I think the ingestion job does 10s scrape but the rollup job does 1m which masks microbursts.

alex: sure, current alert rule (Grafana alerting):
```
max_over_time(sum by(pod) (rate(kv_eviction_count_total[1m]))[5m]) > 0.8
```
That's been firing a lot.

maria: that's the problem — `rate()` over 1m + then `max_over_time` over 5m basically amplifies tiny bursts into sustained signals. we should look at raw `irate()` at 30s or emit a separate `eviction_per_minute` gauge via the exporter.

joel: +1 on adding a gauge. also we should track `kv_residency_percentile{p="90"}` and `kv_fragmentation_ratio` in the SLO dashboard so alerts can be more targeted (eviction rate alone is noisy).

cheng: quick query I ran:
```
sum by(pool) (irate(kv_eviction_count_total[30s]))
/ sum by(pool) (irate(kv_residency_entries_total[30s]))
```
This shows the evictor saturating on one pool, while other pools were fine.

maria: grafana-bot posted the panel snapshot: https://grafana.internal/d/kv/dyn-evict?orgId=1 panel=evict-rate (attached) — you can see the 10s spikes were peaky but the 1m rollup turned them into a brownout-looking trend.

grafana-bot: Alert silence created by maria for 30m on rule `KV Eviction Rate (prod)` :bell:

alex: long-term fixes we sketched: 1) exporter emits per-minute `eviction_per_minute` gauge (stabilized), 2) add `evictor_queue_length` and `evictor_backpressure` counters, 3) change alert to use `increase(kv_eviction_count_total[5m]) > 20` (less sensitive to sub-minute noise), 4) surface residency percentiles (p50/p90/p99) in the infra dashboard.

joel: also worth adding a tiny smoothing job that computes `eviction_rate_rollup_5m = avg_over_time(irate(...)[5m])` so panels can choose raw vs smoothed. we can ship as a meta-metric in the prometheus rules.

cheng: filed PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/evictor-metrics -> adds `eviction_per_minute` exporter and residency percentiles. draft alert updates in infra/monitoring/alerts.yaml.

maria: quick mitigation: lowered alert threshold to `increase(...[5m]) > 25` and added `and kv_residency_percentile{p="90"} < 60` so we only page when eviction is large AND residency is low. pushing change now.

alex: can we also add a lightweight dashboard card that shows sampling skew: `scrape_duration_seconds` and `prometheus_rule_evaluation_duration_seconds` next to eviction panels so owners can see if the rule eval is the culprit?

joel: good call. once PR merges, I'll schedule a 15-min follow-up to validate alarm noise is gone in the next maintenance window.

maria: TL;DR — root cause: short-lived burst + rollup/alert shape mismatch. plan: exporter gauge + percentile metrics + tweak alerts and add rollup variants + dashboard for sampling skew.

alex: thanks all — leave the silence for 30m and we'll monitor. if pages persist after fixes we escalate. :thumbsup:
